first_use_explanation: The calculation allows observations from the same participant to be related and uses the named small-sample correction.
where_technical_term_may_remain: Methods, table notes, and captions after first use.

first_use_explanation: A symlog scale combines a linear section for values from 0 to 1 lx with a base-10 logarithmic section above 1 lx; labels remain in lux.
